translations.Document/Body:
02:10 — The lights went out again.

I left the archive key on the small table by the lockers. Take it and unlock the door at the far end of the hall.

Do not trust the silence.

— Duty officer
translations.Game/Complete: The archive is open. You made it.
translations.Game/InventoryKey:
ARCHIVE KEY
A brass key with a faded paper tag.
translations.Dialogue/01: This is dispatch. Can anyone hear me? The west precinct is in quarantine.
translations.Dialogue/02: The archive key is beside the lockers. Find it and unlock the archive.
translations.Dialogue/03: Keep your flashlight on. And if you hear something behind the door, do not answer.
